sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A 3-phase loop (arm slams → orb collection → burn) that repeats until the boss is dead. Needs two dedicated orb collectors.

sections.heading: Positioning & arm slams
bullets: The squad stacks on the middle two of four platform tiles — the commander calls which tile to defend (commonly the right) when the boss slams.
Dodge or use a defensive cooldown on the slam — getting caught means a knockdown.

sections.heading: Orb collection
bullets: One player collects sword bubbles: grab 4, then use the special action key on the 5th, and repeat — save the final 5 for the next hand phase.
The other collects shield bubbles and saves them rather than using them immediately — they're needed to survive the 50% health check.

When adds spawn off an arm slam, pull them together. Killing them leaves corpses to run through: Conjured Slash (from swords) applies a 50% damage debuff to the boss, Conjured Protection (from shields) prevents squad deaths.

sections.heading: 50% check
bullets: At 50% health, Thunderhead Clap downs the whole squad — counter it with saved shield bubbles or defensive cooldowns, or it's a wipe.
